item.title: Mehdi Lahlou : “La question n’est plus l’extension de l’AMO, mais sa viabilité”
item.description: La généralisation de l’Assurance maladie obligatoire (AMO) est souvent présentée comme l’une des grandes avancées sociales de la dernière décennie au Maroc. item.title: Hedging, speculating, diversifying: the new tools of the Casablanca Stock Exchange
item.description: After years of waiting, Moroccan investors will finally be able to hedge against market fluctuations. The launch of the futures market on April 6, 2026, followed by ETFs and currency funds, is transforming the Casablanca Stock Exchange and reinforcing its ambition to become an African financial hub. item.title: Proactive dam management: a means to preventing disasters
item.description: Faced with increasingly frequent extreme weather events, managing water releases is no longer enough to contain the risk of flooding. Experts and water basin managers are calling for an integrated and proactive approach in a context of climate change that is disrupting water balances.
